title: ジュニアカップの後に・ライバル出現！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After showing off her strength in the Junior Cup, Mejiro Ryan is delighted to have earned her ticket to the place she's dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immediately after, we hear excited cheers from the televised broadcast of another race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin is on the screen, and she's just won her race in spectacular fashion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the broadcast, Ines Fujin challenges Mejiro Ryan to be her rival at the Satsuki Sho. Ryan accepts.
